verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents its own reporting: reports are included in the plan, data can be pulled for marketing-performance dashboards and analysis, and the MCP server can produce flow performance reports. That establishes campaign and flow performance analytics, but the evidence never names the specific metrics, per-step granularity, or trends over time. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of open/click/unsubscribe/conversion metrics, per-automation-step (flow message) breakdowns, time-series reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
